data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Product not as advertised](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a85b6569bba38c820266ff3)
Shipping was fast and communication about the order was good, the product itself is disappointing. The round pillow is not actually round, rather irregular and kind of oblong. Not annoying enough to return the pillow, I feel bad enough about how wasteful shopping online is already, but the product not being as advertised is disappointing.

August 7, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 19, 2026

Hi Ashley,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We appreciate you acknowledging our fast shipping and communication. We are truly sorry to hear that the pillow did not meet your expectations regarding its shape. We understand how frustrating it can be when a product isn't quite as depicted. Your comments are valuable, and we are reviewing our product descriptions and quality control processes to ensure greater accuracy for our customers.

Lulu and Georgia
